overview.title: Procurement Intelligence
overview.description: One entry point for every purchase request, from the first need to delivery and closure, with a named owner at each step.

items.shell: Responsive workspace for desktop, tablet and phone
items.languages: English and French, switchable at any time
items.statusCheck: Live check of the connection to the server and database
items.schema: Database foundation for companies, sites, departments, users and a tamper-evident audit trail

journey.title: What comes next
journey.description: The purchasing journey is delivered stage by stage, each one complete before the next begins.

stages.request: Create and submit a purchase request
stages.approval: Approve, reject or return for revision
stages.purchasing: Assign to a buyer in the purchasing team

overview.demoNote: Companies and sites shown in development are demonstration data. Their names end in “(Demo)”.

planned.title: Planned for sprint {{sprint}}
planned.message: This module is not available yet. It will appear here once it has been built and tested.

descriptions.requests: Create multi-line purchase requests with attachments and track them under a single number.
descriptions.approvals: Review the requests waiting for your decision and act on them from any device.
descriptions.purchasingInbox: Receive approved requests, check them and assign each one to a buyer.
descriptions.sourcing: Invite suppliers, record their quotations and compare them side by side.
descriptions.purchaseOrders: Issue purchase orders from the selected quotation and follow their confirmation.
descriptions.receipts: Record full or partial receipts, damaged goods and other exceptions.
descriptions.organization: Manage companies, sites, departments and cost centres.
descriptions.suppliers: Maintain the supplier register, documents and performance.
descriptions.logistics: Follow local and international shipments step by step, with their transport and customs documents.
descriptions.dashboards: See where every request stands, who owns it, how much it commits and whether it is late.

database.name: Database

error.title: The application server did not respond
error.message: Make sure the backend is running on port 8080, then check again. If it is running, look at its console for errors.

empty.title: The database has no schema yet
empty.message: The database is reachable but no migrations have been applied. Restart the backend to apply them.
